items.title: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland plan to break up the UK
items.summary: The Telegraph reported that the leaders of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland would meet on Monday to sign a deal designed to kick-start the break-up of the United Kingdom. Its post got 74K likes, Pop Base's version got 188K, and "didn't expect to check twitter today and see that the uk is disbanding" got 86K.
items.author: @Telegraph

post.name: The Telegraph
post.text:
The leaders of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland will gather on Monday to sign a deal designed to kick-start the break-up of the United Kingdom, The Telegraph can disclose.
